verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a project instructions or rules file that sets persistent coding standards and conventions for Cline to follow. The closest item is Skills (cline-docs-37), but those are task-specific instruction sets loaded only when relevant to a request. That is an adjacent feature, not an always-applied project conventions file, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a project instructions file to set coding standards and conventions the agent follows
